name: io.github.agent402-dev/a402-pay-mcp
description: Pay x402 APIs (USDC, PREQ) and run Agent402 Bond deals from your own wallet. Refuses by default.

environmentVariables.name: X402_KEYPAIR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the payment wallet key file (Solana CLI JSON). Without it nothing is paid.

environmentVariables.name: X402_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Allowed domains, comma-separated. Empty: every payment refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_TRUSTED_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Trusted recipient addresses, comma-separated. Empty: every payment refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_ALLOWED_ASSETS
environmentVariables.description: USDC (default) or USDC,PREQ. A402 (v1) is deprecated.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Max USDC per payment in USD (default 0.05)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_USD_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Max USDC per UTC day in USD (default 1)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Max payments per UTC day (default 20)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_USD_PER_RECIPIENT_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Max USDC per recipient per UTC day in USD (default off)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PREQ_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Max PREQ per payment, in PREQ smallest units (1 PREQ = 1,000,000). Not set: PREQ refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PREQ_PER_DAY_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Max PREQ per UTC day, in PREQ smallest units (1 PREQ = 1,000,000). Not set: PREQ refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PREQ_PER_RECIPIENT_PER_DAY_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Max PREQ per recipient per UTC day, in PREQ smallest units (1 PREQ = 1,000,000). Default off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_CONFIRM_ABOVE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Ask a human at or above this USDC amount (USD). Default off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_CONFIRM_ABOVE_PREQ_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Ask a human at or above this PREQ amount (PREQ smallest units). Default off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_REQUIRE_LOCK
environmentVariables.description: yes = pay only sellers whose registered on-chain lock meets the minimums (default off)

environmentVariables.name: X402_REQUIRE_LOCK_ABOVE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Require a seller lock only for USDC payments at or above this amount (USD)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MIN_LOCK_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: The minimum must still be locked this many days from now (default 90)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MIN_LOCK_PREQ_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Minimum PREQ locked by the seller, PREQ smallest units (1 PREQ = 1,000,000)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MIN_LOCK_USDC_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Minimum USDC locked by the seller, USDC smallest units (1 USDC = 1,000,000)

environmentVariables.name: X402_MIN_LOCK_SOL_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Minimum wrapped SOL locked by the seller, lamports (1 SOL = 1,000,000,000)

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_SELLERS
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: seller addresses you may open deals with, comma-separated. Empty: bond_open refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: max price per deal (USD). Unset: bond_open refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_MIN_SELLER_BOND_BPS
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: minimum seller bond as a share of the price, basis points (default 500 = 5%).

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_MAX_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: max days from now to the delivery deadline (default 30).

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_CONFIRM_ABOVE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: ask a human at or above this amount in USD (default 0 = always ask).

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_MAX_PREQ_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: max PREQ price per deal, PREQ smallest units (1 PREQ = 1,000,000). Not set: PREQ deals refused.

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_CONFIRM_ABOVE_PREQ_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: ask a human at or above this PREQ amount, smallest units (default 0 = always ask).

environmentVariables.name: X402_BOND_DIRECTORY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Agent402 Bond: seller directory for bond_find_sellers (https). Default: the toolkit list. off = tool off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: mainnet or devnet

environmentVariables.name: X402_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC URL used to build payment transactions

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAY_WITH
environmentVariables.description: Preferred asset: USDC or PREQ

environmentVariables.name: X402_PREQ_MINT
environmentVariables.description: PREQ mint override (only needed before the PREQ mint is built into this version, or for devnet rehearsal)

environmentVariables.name: X402_HISTORY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local payment log (JSONL). Daily limits are counted from this file.
